title: Long-term and low-dose exposure to TDCPP reduces reproductive capacity by enhancing germline apoptosis associated with activation of DNA damage in Caenorhabditis elegans.
authors: Zheng, Shudan; Li, Shangjin; Zhang, Bing; Zhao, Shaojie
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TDCPP暴露对线虫生殖毒性的机制，涉及DNA损伤相关蛋白CLK-2/HUS-1的分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是毒理学而非TF-DNA互作，蛋白-DNA互作仅间接相关。
abstract: Tris (1,3-dichloro-2-propyl) phosphate (TDCPP) arouses increasing attention, which probably poses exposure risks to human reproductive health because it is widely used and distributed. Nonetheless, its toxicities to reproductive system remain largely unknown. With Caenorhabditis elegans being the animal model, this study explored reproductive toxicities induced by TDCPP following long-time and low-dose exposure as well as its associated mechanism. According to our findings, brood size and the hatched egg number markedly decreased, meanwhile, relative area and length of gonad arm markedly declined after 0.1-10 mug/L TDCPP exposure. Additionally, 0.1-10 mug/L TDCPP exposure promoted germline apoptosis, down-regulated ced-9 whereas up-regulated ced-3, ced-4, as well as egl-1 levels; additionally, it aggravated germline DNA damage, accompanied by up-regulated clk-2, cep-1, and hus-1 levels. Finally, computational toxicology, including molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations, showed that TDCPP can effectively embed into the active pockets of CLK-2 and HUS-1 proteins governing DNA damage through interactions such as hydrogen bonds, thereby enhancing the local stability of protein conformation. Consequently, this study illustrated the reproductive toxicities of TDCPP at environmentally relevant concentrations through promoting DNA damage-related germline apoptosis within organisms.
abstract_zh: 磷酸三(1,3-二氯-2-丙基)酯（TDCPP）因其广泛使用和分布，可能对人类生殖健康构成暴露风险，日益引起关注。然而，其对生殖系统的毒性作用仍 largely 未知。以秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）为动物模型，本研究探讨了长期低剂量暴露于TDCPP所诱导的生殖毒性及其相关机制。根据我们的发现，在0.1-10 μg/L TDCPP暴露后，产卵量和孵化卵数显著减少，同时生殖腺臂的相对面积和长度显著下降。此外，0.1-10 μg/L TDCPP暴露促进了生殖细胞凋亡，下调了ced-9，而上调了ced-3、ced-4及egl-1水平；同时，加剧了生殖细胞DNA损伤，伴随clk-2、cep-1和hus-1水平的上调。最后，计算毒理学，包括分子对接和分子动力学模拟，表明TDCPP能有效嵌入调控DNA损伤的CLK-2和HUS-1蛋白的活性口袋，通过氢键等相互作用，增强蛋白质构象的局部稳定性。因此，本研究阐明了TDCPP在环境相关浓度下通过促进生物体内DNA损伤相关的生殖细胞凋亡而诱导的生殖毒性。
